author: Discovery
description:
Watch as passengers try to sneak prohibited items through security at San Francisco International Airport, while Homeland Security officers inspect everything to uncover the truth. Inside one of the nation’s busiest airports, a fugitive attempts to destroy evidence. A woman arriving from the Philippines raises red flags during her “long vacation.” Counterfeit luxury goods from China are stopped upon arrival, and more unfolds behind the scenes.
